On Fri, Aug 8, 2014 at 2:44 AM, Thibault Putseys
<thibault...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> My Shiny App is working perfectly fine with no errors in R in external view,
> but gives the following error after deploying it to Shinyapps.io online :
>
> Application unexpectedly exited, Diagnostic information has been dumped to
> the Javascript console.
>
> This happens as soon as the page opens, I have no idea on how to fix this.
> Any ideas?
> Thanks a lot,
> Thibault

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: App stops working after deployApp()
parts:
Thanks! We have had this problem since day one in the shinyapps
package as well as other packages such as packrat: the automatic
detection of packages will fail if you use library(x, character.only =
TRUE), because it is hard to know what `x` is. It is a little awkward
to type multiple library() expressions, but that is the only way to go
at the moment...

Regards,
Yihui


On Wed, Aug 20, 2014 at 4:48 AM, Thibault Putseys
<thibault...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I replied after solving the issue myself. I was using a shortcut to load in
> several libraries at once, this works in normal R sessions, but didn't seem
> to work when deploying the app.
> For instance:
>
> packages =
> c("quadprog","quantmod","timeSeries","tseries","xts","ggplot2","fGarch",
> "forecast","sde")
> packages = as.matrix(packages,nrow=length(packages))
> for (i in 1:length(packages))
> {require(packages[i],character.only=TRUE)}
>
> But just typing:
> library(quadprog)
> library(quantmod)
> library(timeSeries)
> ...
>
> DID work :)
>
> Hope this helps explaining what went wrong with me?
> Thanks for the concern, let me know if there is still anything else,
> Greets,
> Thibault
